name: Motoyurugidou Mei
source: The protagonist's homeroom teacher. Although she is the advisor for Gekka-kai, the members are always the ones taking care of the affairs, so her being the advisor is in name only. She is a self-centered woman with little dignity as a teacher. Because of this the students are like her friends.
translation: The protagonist's homeroom teacher. Although she is the advisor for Gekka-kai, the members are always the ones taking care of the affairs, so her being the advisor is in name only. She is a self-centered woman with little dignity as a teacher. Because of this the students are like her friends.
